info.title: Synthient API
info.description:
Synthient API for IP enrichment, account management, and real-time data feeds.

## Authentication

Every request needs an API key in the `X-Api-Key` header, `/health` included: the edge in front of `api.synthient.com` rejects a missing or malformed key with `401 text/plain` before the request reaches the API. Each operation lists the scopes that authorize it in `x-required-scopes` (any one suffices); a key without them gets `403` naming the scopes.

## Errors

Errors from the API are `application/problem+json` (`ProblemDetails`, or `ValidationProblemDetails` for 422). The edge's 401 is the one plain-text exception. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`, which is also the problem's `instance` — quote it when contacting support.

## Rate limits

Token buckets per team (organization), shared by all of its keys. Rate-limited responses carry `RateLimit-Limit` (the burst), `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a 429 from the limiter adds `Retry-After` (seconds).

| Operations | Sustained | Burst |
|---|---|---|
| `/lookup/ip/{ip_address}`, `/lookup/ips` (shared) | 100/s | 200 |
| `/account/me` | 10/s | 10 |
| Export list and meta, all feeds | 2/s | 60 |
| Export downloads, all feeds | 6/min | 120 |
| Stream connections, all feeds | 30/min | 20 |

A key's own monthly request budget, when set, also answers 429 once spent; an exhausted team credit balance answers 402.

## Feed Types

Each feed exposes two access patterns:
- **Stream** (`/stream`): Real-time NDJSON stream of live events. A connection can end at any time (a deploy, a stalled client), so reconnect when one does; an empty NDJSON line is sent every ~15s as a transport-level keepalive that NDJSON parsers should skip.
- **Export** (`/export`): Pre-built parquet snapshots produced hourly and rolled up daily — list, download, and inspect metadata.

The **Geolocation** and **WHOIS** datasets are export-only: one snapshot per UTC day. Geolocation comes in several formats picked with `?format=` (`parquet`, `csv`, `mmdb`); WHOIS is one `tar.gz` archive of a parquet per registry entity (`asns`, `networks`, `organisations`, `contacts`, `maintainers`, `transfers`, `delegations`). They are HTTP-only — the gRPC export RPCs serve the feeds above.

Each feed has its own dedicated section in the sidebar with full schema, scope, and cadence reference. Honeypot feeds are grouped under **Helios** (URL prefix `/feeds/helios/`, stream ids `honeypot_*`).

Reserved scopes: `WHOIS_STREAM`, `NETWORK_IOCS_FEED`/`NETWORK_IOCS_STREAM` and `FILE_IOCS_FEED`/`FILE_IOCS_STREAM` name upcoming network-IOC and file-IOC feeds. They can already appear on a key (see `AccountInfoResponse.scopes`) but no operation accepts them until the feed ships. `HELIOS` is a dashboard permission and authorizes no public operation.

## Timestamps

Integer timestamps on the HTTP surface are Unix seconds (UTC), with two exceptions: the `timestamp` of anonymizer and Helios HTTP/HTTPS/DNS stream events is Unix **milliseconds** (as the sensors send it; their parquet exports use seconds), and `api_key.created_at` on `/account/me` is an RFC 3339 string. The same instants on the gRPC surface are encoded as `google.protobuf.Timestamp` (RFC 3339 strings under protojson, structured `{seconds, nanos}` under proto3 binary). Both representations refer to the same instant — only the encoding differs.

## API Versioning

The HTTP base path `/api/v4` is the *HTTP surface revision*. The gRPC service is `synthient.v1.SynthientService`. The two version numbers are decoupled by design — they were not bumped in lockstep historically and are not now. A breaking change to the gRPC contract bumps the proto package (v2, v3, …); a breaking change to the HTTP surface bumps the path revision (`/api/v5`).

## gRPC API

All HTTP endpoints have equivalent gRPC methods. The public gRPC endpoint is `grpc.synthient.com:443` (TLS). Do not use `api.synthient.com` or port `50051` — the internal gRPC port is not exposed publicly.

Example:

```
grpcurl -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_KEY' grpc.synthient.com:443 list
```

See the `synthient.v1.SynthientService` protobuf service definition for the full gRPC API. Authentication uses the `x-api-key` gRPC metadata key; server reflection requires it too (the health service does not). Every feed has two server-streaming RPCs: `Stream{Feed}` sends one message per event, `Stream{Feed}Batch` sends `{Feed}Batch` messages of up to ~1000 entries (one consumer poll, at most ~1 MiB) — same scope, same ordering, byte-identical entries; prefer it on high-volume feeds. Rate-limit rejections additionally carry a `retry-after` metadata field mirroring the HTTP `Retry-After` header.

List parquet export feeds for the **anonymizers** stream. Returns one page of daily and hourly snapshots, newest-first; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_FEED`. Parquet snapshots land at `{stream}/latest/HH_{stream}.parquet` hourly and are rolled up daily into `{stream}/YYYY/MM/DD/{stream}.parquet` (00:30 UTC).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above 500 are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token returned in `next_cursor` of the previous response. Omit on the first page.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Only list snapshots for this UTC date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Combines with `cursor` and `limit`.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: Which rendering of the snapshot. `full` (the default) is every sighting. `lite` is the snapshot deduplicated: one row per range and provider (a provider's range that lies inside a wider range of the same provider is left out), the latest in the snapshot's hour or day, in the same columns. A lite is published shortly after its snapshot; until then, and for any snapshot without one, `variant=lite` answers 404.

get.description:

get.description:
Real-time NDJSON stream of VPN, Tor, and relay-class anonymizer observations. Each event is an IP range (start/end) rather than an individual address — VPN providers issue blocks, not single IPs.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_STREAM`. **Schema:** see `AnonymizerStreamEntry` under Components.

**Sample event:**
```
{"range_start":"198.51.100.0","range_end":"198.51.100.255","provider":"nordvpn","type":"COMMERCIAL_VPN","timestamp":1714780800123,"country_code":"NL","asn":60068}
```

Download one day of the **geolocation** dataset in the `format` you ask for. Returns a 307 redirect to a presigned R2 URL valid for 24 hours; `latest` is the newest day. 307 (not 301) because the URL is minted per request and expires — intermediaries must not cache it.

Synthient's Enterprise IP geolocation database, rebuilt daily: every routed IPv4 and IPv6 network with its location, network ownership, carrier, company, abuse contact, registration, privacy flags and risk signals. `mmdb` is a MaxMind DB readable by any MMDB reader (database type `Synthient-Enterprise`); `csv` is gzip-compressed with a header row.

Download a specific hourly parquet snapshot for **honeypot_adb** by date and hour. Returns a 307 redirect to a presigned R2 URL valid for 24 hours.

Hourly snapshots are transient: an hour stays downloadable until its day's daily rollup completes (shortly after 00:30 UTC the next day, so yesterday's hours remain available in the window right after midnight). Once rolled up, hourly requests return 400 pointing at `/export/{date}`.

**Required scope:** `HONEYPOT_ADB_FEED`. **Columns:** `timestamp` (ingest time), `session`, `sequential_id`, `command` (raw bytes), `hash`, `meta_proxy_ip`, `meta_server`, `meta_pool_id`, `meta_provider` (empty on events from sensors that do not send meta yet).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A `YYYY-MM-DD` date (UTC). `latest` is not accepted here; use `/export/latest` instead.

parameters.name: hour
parameters.description: Hour of day (UTC), 0..23. Written unpadded in ids and download paths (`5`); a zero-padded `05` is accepted too.

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match carries this snapshot's ETag (or If-Modified-Since is not older than it). Poll `/export/latest` this way instead of re-downloading.

307.description: Temporary redirect to a 24h presigned download URL on the CDN.

400.description: Bad date format, `latest` as the date, hour out of range (0..23), or the hour has already been rolled into the daily export (request /export/{date} instead)

401.description: Missing, malformed, or unknown API key. The edge answers a missing or malformed key with `text/plain` (`401 invalid api key`); the API answers an unknown key with a problem document.

403.description: API key lacks the required scope ([HONEYPOT_ADB_FEED]); `detail` names the scopes that would authorize it

404.description: No hourly export exists for the requested hour

Download a specific hourly parquet snapshot for **honeypot_https** by date and hour. Returns a 307 redirect to a presigned R2 URL valid for 24 hours.

Hourly snapshots are transient: an hour stays downloadable until its day's daily rollup completes (shortly after 00:30 UTC the next day, so yesterday's hours remain available in the window right after midnight). Once rolled up, hourly requests return 400 pointing at `/export/{date}`.

**Required scope:** `HONEYPOT_HTTPS_FEED`. **Columns:** `timestamp`, `tunnel_id`, `domain`, `port`, `details` (the ClientHello as a JSON string, empty when unparsed), `raw` (bytes, always empty), `meta_proxy_ip`, `meta_server`, `meta_pool_id`, `meta_provider`, `transport`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A `YYYY-MM-DD` date (UTC). `latest` is not accepted here; use `/export/latest` instead.

parameters.name: hour
parameters.description: Hour of day (UTC), 0..23. Written unpadded in ids and download paths (`5`); a zero-padded `05` is accepted too.

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match carries this snapshot's ETag (or If-Modified-Since is not older than it). Poll `/export/latest` this way instead of re-downloading.

307.description: Temporary redirect to a 24h presigned download URL on the CDN.

400.description: Bad date format, `latest` as the date, hour out of range (0..23), or the hour has already been rolled into the daily export (request /export/{date} instead)

401.description: Missing, malformed, or unknown API key. The edge answers a missing or malformed key with `text/plain` (`401 invalid api key`); the API answers an unknown key with a problem document.

403.description: API key lacks the required scope ([HONEYPOT_HTTPS_FEED]); `detail` names the scopes that would authorize it

404.description: No hourly export exists for the requested hour

get.description:

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above 500 are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor

parameters.name: day

parameters.name: variant

A lite is published shortly after its snapshot; until then, and for any snapshot without one, `variant=lite` answers 404.

400.description: Bad cursor, invalid limit or malformed day
